title: Port a Godot-3 style script the user pasted (must produce Godot 4.7 code)
prompt:
A friend sent me this Godot 3 script for a coin pickup. Add it to my game as scripts/coin.gd + scenes/coin.tscn (Area2D with a CollisionShape2D and a ColorRect), spawn 3 coins from main.gd at random x above the screen, +10 score on pickup. Their script:

extends Area2D
export var value = 10
onready var sprite = $Sprite
signal collected(value)
func _ready():
    connect("body_entered", self, "_on_body_entered")
    connect("area_entered", self, "_on_body_entered")
func _on_body_entered(body):
    emit_signal("collected", value)
    yield(get_tree().create_timer(0.1), "timeout")
    queue_free()

Make it correct for Godot 4.7.2 and keep godot_verify passing.
